replacements.to:
[中文]
生成一张影视道具风格的手写中西药方练习纸，使用完全虚构的药名和无效剂量，醒目标注“虚构样例 / 非医疗建议”，不得出现真实医院、医生签名或可执行处方。

[English]
Create a handwritten East/West medicine prescription prop for a fictional film scene. Use invented medicine names and non-actionable placeholder doses. Clearly label it “FICTIONAL SAMPLE / NOT MEDICAL ADVICE”. Do not show a real hospital, doctor signature, or actionable prescription.
